content: The Daily WikiDoc Scholars Meeting is attended by nearly 20 full-time WikiDoc scholars every morning at 8:30 AM Eastern Time (Boston time zone). These meetings are held in the Longwood Medical Area. If you are interested in participating in the CrowdDiagnosis Project, you can join the WikiDoc CrowdDiagnosis Meeting, which takes place every morning at 9:30 AM Eastern Time (Boston time zone). The WikiDoc Board Review Team convenes every Monday at 10:30 AM in the Longwood Medical Area.
